title: Create migration mutation to copy anonymous data to user account
description: Create convex/migration.ts with mutation to copy all data from visitorId to userId. Called after successful signup when user opted in.

notes: Migration mutation pattern implemented in convex/migration.ts. Uses basic deduplication to avoid overwriting existing authenticated user data if they already started practicing.
